cases.text: Hi all, the Year 3 swimming carnival permission slips are due back to the office by Wednesday 18 November. Thanks, Mrs Ng
Kindly ensure your child brings a named water bottle and hat to school every day this week.
Your GP referral to the cardiology clinic has been processed. Please call 07 5550 1234 to book an appointment before 30 November.
Pls bring $5 cash for the book fair on Tuesday. Thanks!
Your council rates notice for the second instalment is now available. Payment of $612.35 is due on 20 December.
Could you sign the attached enrolment form and return it by Monday?
Reminder: the uniform shop order closes Friday 13 November. Orders placed after that date cannot be filled.
Please submit your vaccination certificate to the front office before the first day of term.
Hi, just letting you know the car park at school will be closed on Thursday for resurfacing.
The excursion to the botanic gardens may move to a different date depending on the weather. We will confirm in due course.
Please return the library books when you can, there is no set date.
A reminder that school photos are coming up soon, so please think about whether you would like to order.
Thanks for sending the form. We are still waiting on the medical specialist report and will let you know once it arrives.
Your application for the Year 7 transition program has been received and is being reviewed. We will be in touch in early December.
Apologies for the delay. We have not yet heard back from the tradesperson about the quote.
The strata committee is still considering the complaint and will respond once a decision has been made.
Payment received for the Term 4 camp, thank you. Your child is all set.
We have now received your signed consent form. No further action is required from you.
Thank you for submitting your registration. Your enrolment is complete.
Your appointment with Dr Patel on Tuesday at 2:30pm has been cancelled by the clinic.
Change of time: the Year 6 assembly has moved from 9am to 1:30pm on Friday.
The swimming lesson on Wednesday has been cancelled due to the pool closure. The makeup session will be on Thursday.
Unfortunately the presentation evening is now on 4 December instead of 27 November.
Thanks everyone who came to the Sports Day, it was a fantastic afternoon for the kids!
Let us know if you have any questions about the new canteen menu.
Your order has been shipped and should arrive within three to five business days.
Jo from the P&C has offered to collect the raffle prizes, so nothing needed from you.
Newsletter: Term 4 is off to a great start. Our next whole-school assembly will be held in the hall.
Happy Diwali from all of us at the school community!
Your payment has already been processed and no action is required. Receipt attached.
